[Experience]{.eyebrow}

***
:::
::: {.timeline}

<details open>
<summary><span><span class="when">Feb 2025 — present</span><span class="role">Economist, Global Poverty Department</span><span class="org">The World Bank · Washington DC</span></span><span class="plus">+</span></summary>
<div class="body">

Innovation and systems engineering; GeoPov, joining geospatial and micro data for global
poverty analysis; fiscal microsimulations at the Micro-Modelling Lab; EU poverty mapping
and missions to Poland; and continuing land-economics research with operational support
to the Ukrainian State Cadastre.

- Implemented agricultural land valuation adopted by the Ukrainian State Cadastre; consulted on LPIS and mass valuation.
- Led Bank-wide adoption of AI-assisted coding in R/Stata; the [ai4coding](https://worldbank.github.io/ai4coding/) course reached 600+ staff.
- Co-initiated GeoPov; introduced Positron and Quarto as Bank-standard tools for reproducible research.

</div>
</details>

<details>
<summary><span><span class="when">Jan 2020 — Dec 2024</span><span class="role">Lecturer (wissenschaftlicher Mitarbeiter)</span><span class="org">Justus Liebig University Giessen · Germany</span></span><span class="plus">+</span></summary>
<div class="body">

Research at the Institute for Agricultural Policy and Market Research on land markets and
institutions, farm restructuring and returns to scale, rental-market efficiency in Ukraine,
and land-policy evaluation in Kazakhstan — alongside two MSc courses and my doctoral thesis.

- Introduced *Applied Econometrics*, teaching the path from cause to effect.
- Researcher on the BMBF-funded ROCHADE project as CGE modeller and global trade data analyst.

</div>
</details>

<details>
<summary><span><span class="when">Mar 2018 — Jan 2025</span><span class="role">Economist, short-term consultant</span><span class="org">The World Bank · Poverty &amp; Equity Global Practice</span></span><span class="plus">+</span></summary>
<div class="body">

Microeconomic analysis of fiscal incidence, geospatial analysis, and country-level capacity
building — delivered largely as reusable software: R packages and Shiny applications that let
governments interrogate their own policy simulations.

- [devCEQ](https://worldbank.github.io/devCEQ/) — fiscal microsimulation apps for Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Benin, Indonesia, Romania, Türkiye, El Salvador, Armenia.
- [devPTIpack](https://worldbank.github.io/devPTIpack) — Project Targeting Index tools across Africa and Asia.
- Founded the [EU Poverty Mapping](https://github.com/wbEUPM) GitHub organisation; land-economics research at DEC.

</div>
</details>

<details>
<summary><span><span class="when">Oct 2017 — Dec 2019</span><span class="role">Researcher</span><span class="org">IAMO · Halle (Saale), Germany</span></span><span class="plus">+</span></summary>
<div class="body">

Land and labour relationships in agriculture, focusing on principal–agent problems and
contractual relations in Ukraine. Led the second wave of the IAMO Farm Survey in Kazakhstan
and Central Asia — questionnaire design, pre-testing, interviewer training, and QA over 600
collected responses.

</div>
</details>

<details>
<summary><span><span class="when">Sep 2014 — Jan 2018</span><span class="role">Trade Economist · Statistician</span><span class="org">FAO of the United Nations · Rome</span></span><span class="plus">+</span></summary>
<div class="body">

Policy briefs for the WTO 11th Ministerial, bilateral trade analysis, and the meat chapter of
the *OECD-FAO Agricultural Outlook 2017–2026*, maintaining AGLINK-COSIMO country modules.
Earlier, as statistician, implemented IPCC-compliant GHG estimation and built the first
emissions-intensities database in FAOSTAT.

</div>
</details>

:::
